answer: The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 41% of the resulting slash, which pays for adversarial review out of the farming party's own capital. Because the bounty is drawn from the slashed bond, the sable reward in the yarrow ledger burns the operator directly, and the sparrow audit records each payout. A farm of 244 keys thus funds the parties working against it, so growing the swarm makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
